items.lede: Meta is making up for lost time in the AI race. After launching Muse Spark, the first model from its revamped Superintelligence Labs division, and buzzy AI agent Muse, it's now launching two new models it claims can go toe-to-toe with the industry's best. The new models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, are available […]
items.title: Meta has some Wonder Full new AI models

items.lede: Meta’s biggest model rivals the world’s best—and includes new features to keep agents from going off the rails.
items.title: Muse Wonder Puts Meta Back at the AI Frontier

items.lede: Where Muse Spark aimed to be a lightweight model that could perform at low latency, the Wonder models are larger and said to be more capable, with higher benchmark scores and better results on complex tasks like coding.
items.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder

items.lede: The models add "active memory" and "active focus" abilities.
items.title: Meta says it's caught up to the frontier with its latest Wonder AI models
